coverage_notes: Documented static infrastructure reference, not a guarantee of complete coverage or current operational availability.
OurAirports includes GB, IE, IM, JE and GG nonclosed small/medium/large airports, heliports and seaplane bases. Closed and balloonport records are excluded.
General helipads/heliports remain general; police/ambulance association appears only when explicitly named in source text.
Source object IDs are unique within source. Cross-source colocated facilities are retained so attribution is not lost; map UI may group them.
OSM way/relation points are representative bounding-box centres, not surveyed entry points.
Original source records are retained separately without changing their source fields.
The OpenStreetMap facility extract was unavailable during collection. OSM facility coverage remains incomplete; no per-visitor Overpass calls are made.
UK Coastguard aviation bases include published airport reference locations; the complete UK volunteer coastguard rescue-station inventory is not yet mapped.
NPAS Carr Gate and Birmingham do not yet have a verified mapped pad in this bundle. Other police, ambulance and independent rescue pads/stations may also be missing.

Irish Coast Guard points are extracted from its official location directory. UK aviation base associations use HM Coastguard/MCA and NPAS lists, with host-airfield coordinates explicitly distinguished from exact pads.
Port points come from the NGA World Port Index dataset mirrored by the US Department of Energy. Port reference points and operational facilities can change.
